chatBackend.label: Execution backend

disclosure.title: External CLI connection
disclosure.common: Sepilot runs the installed official CLI as a local process; it does not copy sign-in tokens or call a private model API on the CLI's behalf. However, your input, image attachments, workspace content read by the CLI, and tool results may be sent to the selected CLI and its model provider. Review the provider's terms, organization policy, charges, usage limits, and data-retention settings. Sepilot's model and tool-approval settings do not govern this external CLI.
disclosure.claude: Claude CLI: Sepilot uses the claude executable's official print/stream interface. Anthropic may treat third-party use of subscription accounts separately and prohibits client impersonation or routing third-party traffic against subscription limits. If your organization permits only approved clients or API authentication, check its policy before enabling this backend.
disclosure.codex: Codex CLI: Sepilot uses the Codex app-server interface intended for external applications and identifies its client name. Your ChatGPT/Codex account and organization data controls, usage limits, and approval policies continue to apply.
disclosure.opencode: OpenCode CLI: The actual data destination and billing or retention policy depend on the model provider (for example, Ollama Cloud) and plugins selected in OpenCode. Confirm that an organization-approved provider and model are selected.
disclosure.other: Review this CLI's authentication method, data handling policy, and whether your organization permits its use.

chatBackend.limits: External CLIs manage the conversation and tools and accept image attachments. Codex-generated images appear in Chat. SEPilot modes, RAG, skills, personas and approval settings do not apply.
chatBackend.imagesOnly: External CLIs accept PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images only: up to 10 MiB each and 8 per turn.
chatBackend.attachmentsUnsupported: This backend does not support attachments. Remove them or select SEPilot.
chatBackend.cliPermissions: File access follows CLI settings; actions requiring additional approval are denied.
chatBackend.prompt: Send a message to the CLI…
